defs.d: One who drives something, in any sense of the verb to drive.
Something that drives something, in any sense of the verb to drive.
The act of cutting.
defs.ex: He made a fine cut with his sword.

defs.d: The result of cutting.
defs.ex: a smooth or clear cut

defs.d: (heading) To incise, to cut into the surface of something.
To admit of incision or severance; to yield to a cutting instrument.
(participial adjective) Having been cut.
Reduced.
defs.ex: Cut brandy is a liquor made of brandy and hard grain liquor.

defs.d: The time of the day between dusk and night, when it gets dark.
The time of the day between the approximate time of midwinter dusk and midnight (compare afternoon); the period after the end of regular office working hours.
(official BIPM spelling, Australian, New Zealand, Irish, Indian and South African spelling) An SI unit of length equal to 103 metres. Symbol: km
Two similar or identical things taken together; often followed by of.
defs.ex: I couldn't decide which of the pair of designer shirts I preferred, so I bought the pair.

defs.d: Two people in a relationship, partnership or friendship.
defs.ex: Spouses should make a great pair.

defs.d: To group into one or more sets of two.
defs.ex: The wedding guests were paired boy/girl and groom's party/bride's party.

defs.d: To bring two (animals, notably dogs) together for mating.
The act of killing.
defs.ex: The assassin liked to make a clean kill, and thus favored small arms over explosives.

defs.d: Specifically, the death blow.
defs.ex: The hunter delivered the kill with a pistol shot to the head.

defs.d: To put to death; to extinguish the life of.
defs.ex: Smoking kills more people each year than alcohol and drugs combined.

defs.d: To render inoperative.
defs.ex: He killed the engine and turned off the headlights, but remained in the car, waiting.

defs.d: To move or develop something.
To exert or experience force.
A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated on a monthly or annual basis, not hourly, as wages. Implies a degree of professionalism and/or autonomy.
To pay on the basis of a period of a week or longer, especially to convert from another form of compensation.
Saline.
To bring (something such as a vehicle) to a halt or store in a specified place.
defs.ex: I parked the drive heads of my hard disk before travelling with my laptop.

defs.d: To defer (a matter) until a later date.
defs.ex: Let's park that until next week's meeting.

defs.d: The action of the verb to park.
defs.ex: Parking in central London can be very difficult.

defs.d: Space in which to park a car or other vehicle.
defs.ex: It can be difficult to find parking in central London.

defs.d: To make real; to convert from the imaginary or fictitious into reality; to bring into real existence
defs.ex: The objectives of the project were never fully realized.

defs.d: To become aware of (a fact or situation, especially of something that has been true for a long time).
defs.ex: He realized that he had left his umbrella on the train.

defs.d: A set of items or amount of material procured or gathered together.
defs.ex: The asteroid belt consists of a collection of dust, rubble, and minor planets.

defs.d: Multiple related objects associated as a group.
defs.ex: He has a superb coin collection.

defs.d: A flying insect, of the clade Anthophila within the hymenopteran superfamily Apoidea, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting pollen and (in some species) producing wax and honey.
The condition of being friends.
A friendly relationship, or a relationship as friends.
Substance consumed to provide energy through combustion, or through chemical or nuclear reaction.
Substance that provides nourishment for a living organism; food.
To provide with fuel.
To exacerbate, to cause to grow or become greater.
The act of departing or something that has departed.
defs.ex: The departure was scheduled for noon.

defs.d: A deviation from a plan or procedure.
defs.ex: There are several significant departures, however, from current practice.

defs.d: The act of receiving, or the fact of having been received.
defs.ex: A balance payable on receipt of the goods.

defs.d: The fact of having received a blow, injury etc.
To give or write a receipt (for something).
defs.ex: to receipt delivered goods

defs.d: To put a receipt on, as by writing or stamping; to mark a bill as having been paid.
defs.ex: to receipt a bill

defs.d: The condition or feeling of being safe; security; certainty.
defs.ex: If you push it to the limit, safety is not guaranteed.

defs.d: A mechanism on a weapon or dangerous equipment designed to prevent accidental firing.
defs.ex: Be sure that the safety is set before proceeding.

defs.d: To secure (a mechanical component, as in aviation) to keep it from becoming detached even under vibration.
To secure a firing pin, as in guns, to keep the gun from firing
One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceived, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:
defs.ex: the youngest victims of the brutal war

defs.d: A living being which is slain and offered as a sacrifice, usually in a religious rite.
To puzzle, perplex, baffle, bewilder (somebody).
To mix up, muddle up (one thing with another); to mistake (one thing for another).
Difficult to understand; not clear as lacking order, chaotic etc
defs.ex: Several sections in that book are really confusing.

defs.d: A disease in which the cells of a tissue undergo uncontrolled (and often rapid) proliferation.
Something damaging that spreads throughout something else.
A stimulant, such as amphetamine, that increases energy and decreases appetite.
The upper portion of something
At a higher level, rank or position.
Situated on higher ground, further inland, or more northerly.
A small river; a large creek; a body of moving water confined by banks.
A thin connected passing of a liquid through a lighter gas (e.g. air).
defs.ex: He poured the milk in a thin stream from the jug to the glass.

defs.d: To flow in a continuous or steady manner, like a liquid.
To extend; to stretch out with a wavy motion; to float in the wind.
defs.ex: A flag streams in the wind.
